Maturity Assessment Results
      QE Maturity Assessment — Seed Analytics
      Prepared for Seed Analytics by Bosch Technologies
      ← Back to Assessment Report
    
  

  
  
    
      

        
        

          
          
            
              1.5
            
            Level 2: Managed
            
              Some structure in place but inconsistently applied.
            
          

          
          
            
          

          
          Dimension Breakdown & Recommendations
          

            
            
              
                 Test Process & Governance
                2.0 / 5.0
              
              
                
              
              
                Recommendation: Standardise your test case format and introduce a lightweight test management tool. Begin tracking defect metrics.
              
            

            
            
              
                 Automation Coverage & Effectiveness
                1.0 / 5.0
              
              
                
              
              
                Recommendation: Begin with automating your most critical smoke tests. Choose a modern framework (Playwright or Cypress) and start small.
              
            

            
            
              
                 Tooling & Infrastructure
                1.5 / 5.0
              
              
                
              
              
                Recommendation: Make test results a blocking gate in your pipeline. Introduce Docker for consistent test environments.
              
            

            
            
              
                 Reporting & Observability
                1.3 / 5.0
              
              
                
              
              
                Recommendation: Start with automated test reports (e.g., Allure or ExtentReports). Make results visible to the whole team.
              
            

            
            
              
                 Team Skills & Culture
                1.8 / 5.0
              
              
                
              
              
                Recommendation: Introduce pair testing sessions. Provide basic automation training for manual testers.
